fields.name: Ramesh Gupta
fields.review: Excellent service and very professional installation team. The 5kW system is working perfectly and my electricity bill has significantly reduced!

fields.name: Anjali Sharma
fields.review: Good experience overall. The sales team was very helpful in explaining the subsidy process. Installation took a day longer than expected, but the quality of work is great.

fields.name: Vikram Singh
fields.review: Highly recommend them! They handled everything from site survey to net-metering. The KSEB approval was smooth and fast. Great job.

fields.name: Sunita Verma
fields.review: We opted for the Leakproof Solar Roof, and it looks beautiful on our house. The team was very polite and cleaned up everything after installation.

fields.name: Amit Patel
fields.review: The solar panels are generating good power, but the initial communication regarding the delivery date was a bit confusing. Overall satisfactory.
